blocks.orig: Spend the night in an amazing place run by the Maasai and spend a lovely day with this amazing tribe. At the Original Maasai Lodge – Africa Amini Life you can immerse yourself in the Maasai culture by trying some typical Maasai skills such as spear throwing, donkey riding, Maasai dancing at sunset or nature walks… or you just stay at the lodge, dive in the pool and enjoy the Maasai culture in the setting of this authentic Maasai lodge.
blocks.html: Stay overnight at a wonderful place run by the Maasai and enjoy a lovely day with this remarkable tribe. At the Original Maasai Lodge – Africa Amini Life you can get to know Maasai culture by trying typical Maasai skills like spear throwing, donkey riding, Maasai dancing at sunset or going on nature walks… or you simply stay at the lodge, jump in the pool and take in Maasai culture in the surroundings of this authentic Maasai lodge.

blocks.orig: If you stay in the Maasai lodge, the activities are for free (recommended because of the long driving distance)
blocks.html: The activities are free when you stay at the Maasai lodge (which we recommend, given the long drive)
